description: §19.16.2 — a `defer` in a loop body is scoped to ONE iteration: it runs at the end of every iteration, including one left by `continue` and the one left by `break`. Iteration 1 falls through (b1 then e1), 2 continues (e2), 3 breaks (e3), 4 never runs: trace = "b1;e1;e2;e3;done;".
rationale: §19.16.2 Registration: the enclosing block of a `defer` in a loop body is that body, once per iteration; Exit: `break` / `continue` out of the block run its deferred bodies.
